verdict.rationale: Railway ships an official CLI that lets developers deploy from the terminal (docs-15, probe-3), and offers one-click starter templates (docs-17). However, nothing shows a single CLI command that both scaffolds a new project and deploys it; the 'one command' claim (docs-19) covers only CLI install and agent setup. Missing for 10: a documented single-command scaffold-plus-deploy flow, CLI-driven template scaffolding, and hands-on corroboration of the CLI deploy workflow.
